title: Worked examples: one scale, four assessment areas
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLES using OUR PROPOSED ANCHOR FRAMEWORK. Fictional groups, fictional evidence. Not University of Iowa findings, not an industry standard, not a certification scale.

criteria.notes: REPEATABLE PRACTICE. Code review runs across the team over a stated window, with exceptions written down.

evidence.note: requires one reviewer on every change

evidence.locator: Sampled merge records, 24 fictional changes, Jan-Mar window
evidence.note: 3 of 24 carry a recorded exception with a stated reason

criteria.notes: POLICY-ONLY CLAIM. Three documents, zero records of the work. The cap is the point: volume of paperwork does not move the level.
MEASURED AND ADJUSTED. An outcome measure with a stated denominator, reviewed, and a change evidenced as following from it.

evidence.locator: Access review records, 4 fictional quarterly cycles

evidence.note: definition, period and denominator all stated; cadence changed from annual to quarterly after Q2 showed stale entitlements

criteria.notes: ISOLATED SUCCESS. One real, well-evidenced instance. Genuine, and not yet a practice.

evidence.locator: Dependency remediation record, one fictional incident

criteria.notes: CAPPED BELOW 4. Repetition is evidenced, but every record belongs to one engineer, so the practice cannot be told apart from one person's habit.
CAPPED BELOW 4 for the other reason: repetition across people, but no exception is recorded anywhere across 18 releases.
MISSING EVIDENCE. Assessed, nothing supplied. Not level 1.
CAPPED BELOW 5. The measure is cited but its denominator is never stated, so it cannot be read.

evidence.locator: Fictional productivity claim in a slide

criteria.notes: NOT APPLICABLE. A fact about how this fictional group operates, not a gap in our evidence.
criteria.applicability_reason: This fictional group runs no model or data pipeline of its own; the criterion has no subject here.

criteria.notes: UNASSESSED. Outside the agreed scope for this fictional group in this round.
CAPPED BELOW 5 for the other reason: the measure is properly defined, but nothing changed as a result of it.
LEVEL 1. A procedure exists nowhere and descriptions disagree.

evidence.note: the two descriptions of the intended practice do not match
